description: This grouped bar chart illustrates GLUE Performance across various Fine-tuning Methods. The horizontal category axis displays the fine-tuning methods, with fully visible labels including LoRA, BitFit, $S_1$-model, $S_4$-model, and $S_5$-model, arranged from left to right alongside partially obscured labels on the far left. The vertical value axis represents GLUE Performance on a linear scale, featuring numeric tick marks at 86 and 88 with an interval of 2, indicating a truncated baseline that does not start at zero. The data is represented by grouped bars, where each fine-tuning method category contains two side-by-side bars corresponding to "RoBERTa Size," as indicated by the legend. Within each group, the left bar represents the "base" size and is colored blue, while the right bar represents the "large" size and is colored orange. Across all visible categories, the orange "large" bars consistently reach higher values than their corresponding blue "base" bars. The shortest visible bar is the blue "base" bar in the leftmost, partially obscured category, falling below the 86 mark, whereas the tallest bar is the orange "large" bar in the rightmost "$S_5$-model" category, extending significantly above the 88 mark. The categories do not appear to be sorted alphabetically, and there are no specific visual emphases such as shading or outlines applied to individual bars.
